reason: A spec-driven development workflow plugin that manages proposal, approval, implementation, verification, and archival through /spec commands, with filesystem operations, agent-generated content, shell-based checks, and model-assisted verification.

summaries.zh: 通过 /spec 命令管理从规格提案、审批、实现到逐条验收和归档的软件开发闭环。
summaries.en: A /spec command workflow for managing software changes from specification proposal and approval through implementation, verification, and archival.

capabilities: Creates and manages OpenSpec-compatible specification files
Uses agent steering to generate proposals and implementation content
Runs declared bash verification commands through the workspace shell
Executes implementation tasks after an approval gate
